entries.name: Erik Lee Madison
entries.charges: Sexual exploitation of a child (10 minor female victims), cyberstalking
entries.source: DOJ: Violent Extremist Network '764' Member Pleads Guilty
entries.notes: Madison sexually exploited at least 10 minor female victims, coerced them to self-harm, cut signs into their bodies, and extort them.

entries.name: Aaron Corey (aka 'Baggeth')
entries.source: DOJ: New York Man and Alleged Member of 764 Charged
entries.notes: Corey received video and image files depicting pre-pubescent minors engaged in sexually explicit conduct between October and December 2025.

entries.name: Leonidas Varagiannis (aka 'War')
entries.charges: Operating an international child exploitation enterprise, conspiracy to produce and distribute CSAM, coercion and enticement of minors
entries.source: DOJ: Leaders of 764 Arrested and Charged
entries.notes: Led a core subgroup within 764 known as '764 Inferno.' Allegedly exploited at least eight minor victims across multiple jurisdictions.

entries.name: Prasan Nepal (aka 'Trippy')
entries.charges: Operating an international child exploitation enterprise, conspiracy to produce and distribute CSAM, coercion and enticement of minors
entries.source: DOJ: Leaders of 764 Arrested and Charged
entries.notes: Co-led '764 Inferno' with Varagiannis. Created 'Lorebooks' used as digital currency within the network.

entries.name: Marek Cherkaoui
entries.charges: Cyberstalking a minor, expressed support for mass shooters, solicited CSAM from minors
entries.source: DOJ: New Jersey Man Charged with Cyberstalking
entries.notes: Threatened a minor female and told her to cut herself; she cut her arms on two occasions. Planned to join ISIS and commit acts of terrorism.

entries.name: Dong Hwan Kim
entries.charges: Possession of child pornography, enticement of minors, extortion
entries.source: FBI: Downey Man Suspected of Membership in 764 Arrested
entries.notes: Enticed minor females to produce CSAM, threatened to send naked photographs to family members. Used monikers 'Ryzen' and 'Lobster.'

entries.name: Juvenile (17-year-old, Maine)
entries.status: First juvenile in US federally charged, adjudicated, and detained for 764-related acts (September 1, 2026)

entries.source: FBI Boston: Maine Teenager Is First Juvenile in the Nation
entries.notes: First-in-the-nation case. FBI is now investigating over 500 subjects nationwide tied to 764.
